# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen to nineteen years old  <sub>[v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044), [v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c35 P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P33](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0033)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c35 P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is a stunningly attractive young woman with a striking, uneven, and captivating beauty. She has glossy, nut-brown hair, dark-lashed, plush brown eyes under dark, uniquely angled eyebrows, a pale complexion with a soft, mature warmth, and a wide, rose-colored, asymmetrical mouth. She is of shorter stature and has a slightly plump figure.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c33 P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Cressida is lively, talkative, and intensely romantic, often treating life and her relationships with playful lightheartedness and dramatic flair. Despite appearing shallow, vain, and indecisive on the surface, she possesses a sweet, womanly, and deeply loyal heart. She readily admits her flaws and enjoys bringing cheer and fun to her companions, valuing genuine affection and friendship over mere social conventions.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P27](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0027), [v3 c4 P35](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0035), [v3 c4 P61](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0061), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021)_

## History

Cressida attended Regent's Academy, where she participated in the student Story Club alongside Nell Harcourt and others. She later enrolled at Wexcombe College, where her beauty and charm made her an immediate social success among the student body. She befriended Nell and Honora Hollis, arranging for them to rent Tabby's Place together for their lodging. Over her college years, she managed her courtships with two home-town suitors, Hector and Orlando, before falling deeply in love with Ezra Hale, a plain, dedicated theology student. After completing her studies and winning Honors in Mathematics, she accepted Ezra's marriage proposal and agreed to join him in his work at a mission church in the slums.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v3 c4 P27](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0027), [v3 c4 P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014), [v3 c10 P58](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0058), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018), [v3 c27 P30](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0030), [v3 c37 P3](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0003)_
